body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage, or 2 if the target voluntarily moved away from you since your last turn.

surges.html: Move 1 unit toward the target before rolling.
On a hit, the target is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Finisher
rider.html: After a hit, spend 2 Combo to follow the target up to 2 units the next time it voluntarily moves before your next turn; this follow does not trigger movement Reactions.
